name: blast-preview-step-visual
description: Redesign P4/#25: the Blast Workshop's Preview step — Analysis Suite tier list (buy real SOFTWARE_TIER_COSTS tiers) and Predicted rows (Run Analysis against the real blast_preview command, tier-gated).

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site, charged and sequenced so the plan is valid. Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: role: bootstrap (issue #515): the Charge step right after this one is the panel's own designated first-open (`#bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"]`, a toggle) — giving this step its own panel-open click would leave the panel open here and then CLOSE it when the charge step's click ran. No dragTiles-based grid-tool conversion was attempted here for that reason, not because one doesn't exist for a 1x1 grid. #553: confirming the grid queues 1 drill_hole PendingAction and pushes 1 PlannedHole into plannedDrillHoles — not drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm.

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — the staffed driller/drill_rig lands the single hole well inside this pad (sandbox-measured landing at tick 20).

Declared boomite/5kg/2m is exactly what the Charge panel shows on a fresh page (DEFAULT_EXPLOSIVE/DEFAULT_AMOUNT_KG/DEFAULT_STEMMING_M, Charge.ts), so Charge All commits the declared values with no stepper click at all — asserted rather than assumed. The Blast Workshop is opened here (same shape as blast-fire-step-visual.json's charge step); the step below no longer needs its own panel-open click since the panel is already open by then.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

role: bootstrap (issue #515): `sequence set hole:H1 delay:0ms` sets an ABSOLUTE per-hole delay — the panel only exposes relative +/- steppers ([data-hole="H1"] [data-action="delay-inc"/"delay-dec"], Sequence.ts), so there is no click path to a specific value, only to whatever the steppers already show.

Switching to step 4 (Preview) shows the Analysis Suite: T1 buyable, T2-4 not yet, and Predicted showing 'run analysis to see predictions' since none has run. The panel is already open (opened by the charge step above), so no panel-open click here — #bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"] is a toggle (UIManager.togglePanel), so clicking it again would have closed it.
Buying T1 (real $500 cost) shows it owned (green check) and makes T2 the next buyable tier
Run Analysis populates the Predicted rows with real energy data (T1 owned); fragmentation/projection/vibration rows stay locked behind their tier
Run Analysis stays clickable once all 6 Predicted rows are populated — the fully-grown layout does not push it below the panel's fold (the failure mode #24 found in the Charge step's product list)

expect.note: the specific regression this file guards against (#24) — a fully-grown Predicted list must not push Run Analysis below the panel's fold
